description: Child process management (supervised processes with crash restart and backoff), GitHub integration (clone/pull), env var validation, deploy pipeline (git pull + validate + compile + start), and host-header routing (reverse proxy from port 80 to internal app ports).
steps: Create src/doot/dootd_process.nim - Child process supervisor. Types: ChildProcess object (pid, appId, appName, internalPort, process handle, status, restartCount, lastCrashTime, backoffMs). ProcessSupervisor object (children table by appId, maxRestarts=5, restartWindow=60 seconds, initialBackoffMs=1000, maxBackoffMs=30000). Functions: startChild(supervisor, appConfig, binaryPath) starts process with osproc.startProcess, captures stdout/stderr via output streams, assigns internal port via PORT env var. stopChild(supervisor, appId) sends SIGTERM, waits up to 5 seconds, then SIGKILL. restartChild(supervisor, appId) implements exponential backoff: if crashed more than maxRestarts times within restartWindow seconds, mark as error state and stop restarting. calculateBackoff(restartCount) returns min(initialBackoffMs * 2^restartCount, maxBackoffMs). checkChildren(supervisor) polls all child processes, detects exits, triggers restart logic. captureOutput(supervisor, appId, stream, line) stores log line in the dootd.db app_logs table.

Create src/doot/dootd_github.nim - GitHub integration for clone and pull. Functions: cloneRepo(githubUrl, pat, branch, destDir) runs 'git clone --branch <branch> https://<pat>@github.com/user/repo.git <destDir>' using osproc.execProcess. pullRepo(pat, branch, repoDir) runs 'git pull origin <branch>' in the repo directory. Both return (success: bool, output: string). The PAT is embedded in the URL for HTTPS auth. sanitizeGitUrl(url, pat) converts 'https://github.com/user/repo' to 'https://<pat>@github.com/user/repo.git'. validateGithubUrl(url) checks URL format is a valid GitHub repo URL.

Create src/doot/dootd_envcheck.nim - Environment variable validation. Functions: extractEnvReferences(doFileContent) scans .do file content for env("KEY") patterns using simple regex/string matching (find all occurrences of env(" and extract the key). scanProjectEnvVars(projectDir) walks all .do files in the project directory and collects all referenced env var keys. validateEnvVars(required: seq[string], configured: Table[string,string]) returns (valid: bool, missing: seq[string]). formatMissingEnvError(appName, missing) returns a user-friendly error message listing missing vars.

Create src/doot/dootd_deploy.nim - Deploy pipeline orchestrator. Types: DeployResult object (success, error, logs seq of string). Function: deployApp(db, appConfig, appsDir) executes the full deploy flow: (1) Clone or pull: if app dir doesn't exist, clone; otherwise pull. (2) Validate env vars: scan project .do files, check against configured env vars in appConfig. (3) If validation fails, return error with missing vars list. (4) Compile: for now, generate a placeholder since full Doot compilation pipeline is complex - the important thing is the flow is correct. In a real deploy this would parse .do files, generate Nim, and compile. (5) Return success. The dashboard calls this from POST /apps/:id/deploy. Store deploy progress/result in app status.

Create src/doot/dootd_router.nim - Host-header based reverse proxy. Types: ProxyRoute object (hostname, internalPort, appId). HostRouter object (routes seq of ProxyRoute, dashboardPort, routerPort). Functions: newHostRouter(port=80, dashboardPort=8080) creates router. addRoute(router, hostname, internalPort, appId). removeRoute(router, appId). findRoute(router, hostname) returns the matching ProxyRoute or nil. startRouter(router) starts async HTTP server on routerPort, for each request: extract Host header, find matching route, forward request to localhost:internalPort (using async HTTP client), return response to caller. If no route matches, return 404 response. If the target app is down, return 503. forwardRequest(targetPort, req) creates a new HTTP request to localhost:targetPort with same method, path, headers, body and returns the response.

Wire deploy into dashboard - Update dootd_dashboard.nim POST /apps/:id/deploy handler: load app config, call deployApp, update app status in DB, redirect to app detail page with success/error message. After successful deploy, call supervisor.startChild to launch the process. Update the host router with the new app's hostname/port mapping.

Create src/doot/dootd_cgroups.nim - cgroups v2 isolation (Linux-specific). Functions: cgroupsAvailable() checks if /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers exists. createAppCgroup(appName) creates /sys/fs/cgroup/dootd/<appName> directory. setMemoryLimit(appName, limitMb) writes to memory.max file. setCpuShares(appName, shares) writes to cpu.weight file. addProcessToCgroup(appName, pid) writes pid to cgroup.procs file. removeAppCgroup(appName) removes the cgroup directory. All functions are no-ops if cgroupsAvailable() returns false (graceful degradation on systems without cgroups).

Add process/deploy/routing tests to tests/test_dootd.nim - Test: backoff calculation (exponential with cap), restart detection logic (more than 5 crashes in 60s marks error), env var extraction from .do file content (finds env("KEY") patterns), env var validation (detects missing vars), missing env error formatting, GitHub URL validation and sanitization, host-header routing (correct app found by hostname, unknown host returns nil), deploy flow with missing env vars fails fast, proxy route add/remove/find operations, cgroups file path generation, systemd service file contains correct ExecStart path.
acceptance_criteria: Process supervisor can start/stop child processes and detect crashes
Exponential backoff prevents restart loops (caps at max, stops after threshold)
GitHub clone/pull functions construct correct git commands with PAT
Env var validation scans .do files and detects missing variables
Deploy pipeline executes steps in order and fails fast on missing env vars
Host-header router correctly maps hostnames to internal ports
Unknown hosts get 404, down apps get 503 from the router
cgroups module creates correct file paths and degrades gracefully
verification: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc --passL:-largon2 --passL:-lssl --passL:-lcrypto -r tests/test_dootd.nim
export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c src/doot.nim
findings: All 6 modules compile independently and as part of the main binary. 222 tests pass (up from 127). Deploy pipeline handles local git repos gracefully - if pull fails but .do files exist in the directory, it proceeds with current code (useful for local development and testing). The extractEnvReferences function requires env( to not be preceded by a word character to avoid false matches with environment( or myenv(. cgroups functions are all no-ops in the sandbox (cgroupsAvailable returns false). The strtabs module is needed in dootd_process.nim for newStringTable in process environment.
